data.body_html:
Choosing between the Astondoa 40 and the Sunseeker Predator 55 for your Marbella charter in 2036? This comparison breaks down size, capacity, price, and inclusions so you can decide which fits your group and budget. Both depart from Puerto Banús, but they serve different needs.

Astondoa 40 vs Sunseeker Predator 55: Key Differences at a Glance

The Astondoa 40 is a 12.5-metre motor yacht accommodating up to 9 passengers, with all-inclusive pricing from €749 for 2 hours to €2,299 for 8 hours. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is a larger 17.1-metre sports yacht for up to 12 guests, offering higher speeds and more deck space. However, the Predator 55 is not in our standard fleet — we can source it on request, with pricing via WhatsApp.

Size and Capacity Comparison

The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is ideal for intimate groups or families. The Sunseeker Predator 55 (17.1m, 12 pax) gives you extra room for entertaining or a bigger party. If you're a group of 8–10, the Astondoa 40 is perfect; for 10–12, consider the Predator 55 or our other large yachts.

Price and Inclusions

Astondoa 40: €749/2h, €1,149/4h, €1,699/6h, €2,299/8h — all inclusive (skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, VAT). Sunseeker Predator 55: pricing on request. Typically, larger yachts cost more, but we can customise a quote. Both include the same core inclusions: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% Spanish VAT.

Performance and Speed

The Astondoa 40 cruises at around 26 knots, comfortable for coastal cruising. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is a performance yacht, reaching 35–40 knots. If you want to cover more coastline or enjoy a faster ride, the Predator 55 excels. For leisurely trips along the Golden Mile or to Cala del Faro, the Astondoa 40 is ample.

Which One Should You Choose?

Choose the Astondoa 40 if: you have up to 9 guests, want transparent all-inclusive pricing, and prefer a proven, comfortable charter. Choose the Sunseeker Predator 55 if: you need capacity for up to 12, desire higher speed, and are flexible on budget (pricing on request). For a direct comparison, see our full fleet page.

How to Book

Ready to book the Astondoa 40? Reserve online with instant confirmation. Interested in the Sunseeker Predator 55? Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and duration — we'll source it and send a quote. All charters depart from Puerto Banús, with optional pick-ups at Marbella Marina, Cabopino, or Estepona.

The Sunseeker Predator 55 is generally faster, with top speeds around 35–40 knots, while the Astondoa 40 cruises at about 26 knots. If speed is a priority, the Predator 55 is the better choice.
